Ethan Brown: Heads-up 9: new hire Ana started this month as L3 (IC) but her manager believes she should be L4 based on prior scope. Manager wants an expedited midcycle leveling + comp uplift effective start date. Is that doable?
Leah Chen: We can do midcycle level-ups but need the standard evidence packet. For external hires converted -> internal title bumps we watch for offer/backfill implications.
Ravi Patel: @ethan did the manager include concrete examples vs the hiring profile? We need 2-3 artifacts (designs, PRs, customer impact) and peer comps.
Ethan Brown: Manager uploaded a short dossier in the hiring folder and asked to fast-track due to retention risk. They're requesting both title and salary bump from day one.
People Ops Bot: Reminder: submit "Midcycle Leveling" form: https://redwooduniverse/internal/forms/midcycle-leveling. Required: employee ID, hire date, evidence link, requested level, requested comp, manager rationale.
Leah Chen: Two routing notes: (1) Lateral promotions or cross-functional title changes still route to Comp Committee. (2) If hire was within 30 days, we also check the offer letter (can't reduce previously promised comp, but can increase).
Ravi Patel: Payroll timing: to make the comp change effective in the next pay run, comp approval + final csv must be in by the payroll cutoff: 11:59pm PT on the 15th. Otherwise it goes into the following cycle.
Comp Committee: Quick check 9: we normally avoid changing grade retroactively for hires <30 days without director attestation and hiring manager calibration. If there's clear business impact we can approve an exception.
Ethan Brown: What's the ask for evidence detail? Manager submitted 1 page summary + 2 PR links. Is that sufficient?
Leah Chen: Usually 3 evidence points + at least one peer comparator at target level. If manager is short, they can add a short calibration note from the director saying why this candidate meets L4 expectations.
Ravi Patel: Side note: if we bump base pay above offer band, finance approval may be required for incremental budget.
Finance: Confirmed. Any comp moves outside standard budgeted bands require Finance sign-off. Also need to check headcount vs forecast.
Ethan Brown: OK. Manager willing to add director calibration. If Comp Committee approves, can we also do equity proration for the higher level? Manager asked for full refresh.
Comp Committee: Equity refresh outside regular grants triggers equity ops flow. We can approve grant sizes but equity ops needs 5-7 business days to mint and send docs. Expect lag.
Leah Chen: Communication guidance: tell the employee we are reviewing a leveling request and it may change comp. Avoid promising specific backpay until it's approved. Use the script: "Manager: We're submitting a request to review your level and compensation; we'll update you once approvals complete."
People Ops Bot: Template: https://redwooduniverse/internal/templates/leveling-comm. Auto-populated fields: effective_date, requested_level, manager_notes.
Ravi Patel: If the manager requests retro-backpay to the hire date and approval is after payroll cutoff, payroll can do a one-time backpay lump in next cycle. We can do retro up to 90 days; beyond that needs Finance escalation.
Ethan Brown: Good to know. Anything about title on offer letter? We don't want conflicting records.
Leah Chen: If offer letter went to candidate with explicit title/level, we respect that as the official starting title unless legal/hr change process changes it. Any post-hire leveling should be recorded in Workday and linked to the new personnel action.
Ravi Patel: Action items: (1) Manager to add director calibration note + one more evidence artifact. (2) Ethan to submit midcycle form with requested effective date = hire date. (3) People Ops to route to Comp Committee and Finance if comp exceeds band.
Ethan Brown: On it. I'll submit the form and tag this thread. Thanks all.
People Ops Bot: Form submitted by Ethan Brown (link: https://redwooduniverse/internal/forms/submissions/239450). Notification sent to comp-committee@redwood.com and finance@redwood.com.
Comp Committee: We'll review within 3 business days. If urgent, mark as "retention-critical" in the form to fast-track.
Ethan Brown: Marked as retention-critical. Appreciate the quick review.
Leah Chen: Once approved People Ops will send payroll CSV + equity ops ticket. Keep this thread for the communication draft to the employee.
Ethan Brown: Will do. Thanks! :thumbsup:
